    legacy_e3_observer = cfg.get('legacy_e3_observer', True)

        raise RuntimeError('legacy_e3_observer must be a JSON boolean')
    for name, val in [('IOMMUDSFixedDelayInput', cfg['ds_delay_input']),
                      ('IOMMUDSFixedDelayOutput', cfg['ds_delay_output']),
                      ('IOMMULegacyE3Observer', legacy_e3_observer)]:
        data, n = re.subn(r'(localparam int unsigned '+name+r'\s*=\s*)\d+', lambda m:m[1]+str(int(val)), data)
        if n != 1: raise RuntimeError(f'Missing unique hardware parameter: {name}')
    top.write_text(data)

notes: Assumption: configs/migration-4dma-research-v1.json is the active research profile being changed. If that file must remain immutable, instead create a new profile JSON with the same fields plus legacy_e3_observer:false and add it to platform.py --profile choices; Codex should own that profile/version-lock closure.

ariane_xilinx.sv and ariane_peripherals_xilinx.sv live in the cva6 component. The builder stages cva6 from the pinned commit, so these RTL changes must be committed in cva6 and sources.lock.json must be updated. No lock-file edit is proposed here; Codex handles version-lock closure.
Default IOMMULegacyE3Observer=1 preserves existing profiles that omit the key. The new profile key false makes the builder replace the unique localparam with 0.
dma_controlled_launcher is untouched. It remains instantiated under InclIOMMU and keeps its existing cfg/launch wiring; only the legacy E3 observer instantiation is made conditional.
No RAM pipeline or read-handshake changes are proposed.

dma_observer e3_control_o inspection: e3_control_o is assigned unconditionally at dma_observer.sv lines 103-105. With E3Enable=0, e3_q can only be set in the ARM write path at line 496, guarded by (!cfg_wdata_i[27] || (E3Enable && ...)); e3_arm at line 497 is under the same guard; delay_n at line 498 is reachable only when bit28 implies bit27, so it is also blocked. Therefore bits 0,1,3,4,5,6,7 of e3_control_o are zero whenever E3Enable=0. The only field that can pulse is bit 2, path_clear, on a CLEAR write (line 463). path_clear is not connected to rv_iommu_top's E3 inputs; those are e3_control[0], [1], [3], and [7]. So no additional zero-gating of e3_control_o is required for correctness.

Because ControlledEnable and E3Enable are now both gated by InclIOMMU && IOMMULegacyE3Observer, while ResearchEnable/PathEnable/P4MEnable remain gated only by InclIOMMU, the dma_observer Magic at 0x58 changes for the research profile. With ResearchEnable=1 it reports 64'h49444d414f425308 instead of the legacy controlled-E3 magic 64'h49444d414f425306. That is a capability advertisement change the driver must expect; RTL zero-gating of e3_control_o would not change it.
When IOMMULegacyE3Observer=0, the new generate else branch drives e3_data='0 and e3_error=1'b0. There are no duplicate drivers: only one generate branch is elaborated.
